title: The assistant goes public
lede: What changed when anyone could talk to one?
body: The first mass-market language model product was not a chatbot. GitHub Copilot put a code model inside developers' editors in mid-2021. But the inflection came on 30 November 2022, when OpenAI released ChatGPT, a free chat interface to the InstructGPT recipe. It reached an estimated hundred million users within about two months.

It is worth being precise about what ChatGPT was. It introduced no new capability; OpenAI described it as a sibling of InstructGPT. It was a breakthrough in interface and distribution. The capability jump came four months later with GPT-4, and Anthropic's Claude made the frontier a competition.
transition: From here the story splits. Several threads develop at once, so each of the next chapters follows one of them from its origin to the present.
